extracted.intended_audience: advanced undergraduate or beginning graduate students studying enumerative combinatorics (textbook readers and instructors)
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of textbook exercises in enumerative combinatorics covering compositions, partitions, generating functions, Stirling and Eulerian numbers, permutation statistics, and related bijective and generating-function proofs. Problems range in difficulty and often request combinatorial, bijective, or generating-function proofs.
